reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that adds a right-edge conversation outline for previewing, searching, and jumping to questions in long chats.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加右侧对话大纲，用于预览、搜索并跳转到长对话中的问题。
summaries.en: Adds a right-edge conversation outline to DeepSeek Harness Web for previewing, searching, and jumping to questions in long chats.

capabilities: Adds a right-edge conversation outline rail to the DeepSeek Harness Web interface
Previews question text and timestamps on hover or touch
Navigates to selected conversation messages and highlights them
Filters questions and loads older conversation history
Updates the outline as new questions appear in the current session
